name: Growth Marketing
description: Grow a product's audience without guesswork: describe the project once (audiences, personas, goals, channels), get a sourced weekly market watch (trends, competitors, communities, media, creators, events), a scored channel strategy with 30 and 90 day plans and bounded experiments, ready-to-publish campaigns (posts, video scripts, press kits, calendar with UTM links) and a weekly review of what works. Every action waits for the owner's one-word decision on a GitHub board; nothing is published without approval.
